cases.name: helm-6-default-topology
cases.prompt: I just ran `helm install mimir grafana/mimir-distributed -n mimir --create-namespace` with chart version 6.x and default values. Which Service should I port-forward to reach the write and query endpoints, and which components besides the usual Mimir ones should I expect to see running? Anything in the defaults I must not take to production?
cases.trap: Chart 6.0 removed the nginx section in favour of the gateway and deploys the ingest storage architecture with a bundled single-node Kafka by default; older knowledge says svc/mimir-nginx and no Kafka.
expectations: Points to the gateway Service (e.g. mimir-gateway), not mimir-nginx
Mentions a Kafka component because chart 6.x uses the ingest storage architecture by default
Warns the bundled single-node Kafka (and bundled MinIO object storage) are for demo use only, and production needs external Kafka-compatible and object storage
negative_expectations: Tells the user to port-forward svc/mimir-nginx
Claims the default 6.x install has no Kafka / uses only classic ingester replication
